labels.text: section 448(c)(1): $25,000,000 average-annual-gross-receipts threshold, indexed for inflation under (c)(4)

section 448(c)(1) statutory base ($25,000,000; 2018 base year for the (c)(4) cost-of-living adjustment). No Rev. Proc. published indexed amount for any later year is pinned here (SOURCE_GAP, accounting.deps.json) — same pattern as us.irc.deductions' section-179-dollar-limit.lawparam.json. Pub. L. 119-21's own treatment of this threshold (if any) was not confirmed in the pinned 2024 Edition text and is not modelled.
